title: Site inspection app for a construction company
brief_text:
Project: site inspection app for a construction company.
- Inspectors fill in safety checklists on a tablet at the site, even without signal.
- Each checklist item can have photos with GPS coordinates attached.
- Site managers approve or send back each inspection report.
- Open defects are assigned to a subcontractor with a due date.
- Subcontractors get an SMS when a defect is assigned to them.
- A weekly PDF report per project is generated for the client.
- Sync projects and subcontractors from our ERP every night.
- Head office sees all projects; site managers only their own sites.
- We might add a client portal later so owners can view the reports themselves.
- Search past inspections by site, date or inspector.
- The system must handle 500 inspectors submitting at the same time at month end.
- If budget allows, use AI to detect missing safety gear in the photos.
expected_ambiguities: AI safety-gear detection if budget allows
